hero.heading: Your body keeps a quiet rhythm
hero.subtitle: Track your cycle, learn about your health, and prepare for informed conversations with your clinician.

tracking.title: Menstrual health tracking
tracking.description: Record period start and end dates, flow intensity, mood, and symptoms. Over time you'll see your own cycle length and period duration — your baseline, not an average. We never invent dates or present estimates as facts.

education.title: Women's health education
education.description: Original articles on menstrual health, PCOS, endometriosis, nutrition, preventive care, and when to seek medical attention — each with references to reputable health organizations.

journal.title: Wellness journal
journal.description: Write daily notes about how you're feeling. Track mood, energy, and patterns over time. Your private space for health reflections.

screening.title: Image-assisted anemia screening
screening.description: HerHealth AI's first screening feature works with two kinds of photos: a close-up of your inner lower eyelid (conjunctiva), and a close-up of a fingernail or nail bed. Changes in pallor can be associated with anemia — but photos alone cannot measure hemoglobin or confirm anything.
screening.honest_title: Honest about what this is — and isn't
screening.honest_text: Real AI analysis is not available yet. No model has been validated or integrated, so this will never return a fabricated anemia probability. A blood test is the only way to confirm anemia.

privacy.heading: Privacy & responsible design
privacy.text: Your health records are yours. Cycle entries, journal notes, and wellness data are stored locally in your browser — not on remote servers or shared with third parties.

local.title: Stored locally

nocollect.title: No silent data collection
nocollect.body: No third-party AI services. No logging of image contents.

control.body: Delete your data at any time from settings.

screening.title: Anemia Screening
screening.subtitle: An image-assisted research prototype. This is not a diagnostic tool.
screening.prototype_note: This feature is a research prototype. No validated AI model is integrated. It will never return a fabricated diagnosis.
screening.what_it_is_desc: Changes in eyelid pallor and nail bed color can sometimes be associated with anemia. This prototype explores whether image capture could support awareness — but a blood test (complete blood count) is the only way to confirm anemia.
screening.consent_text: Images you upload are validated locally (file type and size). They are processed only to display a preview and to record that an attempt was made. No image content is analyzed, stored permanently, or sent to a third party.
screening.guidance_eyelid: Look straight ahead, gently pull the lower lid down, use natural light, no flash.
screening.guidance_nail: Natural nails only, daylight, no filters, hold camera steady.
screening.limitation_text: This prototype cannot and does not analyze images for anemia. No result, probability, or diagnosis will be returned. Please consult a clinician for any health concerns.
